verdict.rationale: The OpenAI API is a platform, not an agent, so whether it ships an official MCP server is a fair question. The evidence only shows the API acting as an MCP client: models can call 'remote MCP servers' as tools. Nothing in the pack documents an official OpenAI-published MCP server that an external agent could connect to, so that client-side capability is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
